subject: Life Skills
title: Building a Family Emergency Plan
description: A quick, practical guide to Building a Family Emergency Plan.

hook.text: The earthquake hit at noon. Mom was at work, dad at a store, kids at school. Nobody knew where to meet.

buildup.text: In a disaster, cell networks overload within minutes. Texting often works when calls fail, but even texts can lag.

discovery.text: Pick two meeting points: one near home for small emergencies, one outside the neighborhood for evacuations.

twist.text: Choose an out-of-area contact everyone calls. Long-distance lines clear faster.

climax.text: Write the plan on a card each family member carries.

punchline.text: Two spots, one contact, written on a card. Plan done.

quiz.question: Why should your emergency contact be outside your area?
options: They are less likely to be affected and long-distance lines clear faster
They can physically come help you quicker
Local contacts cannot receive calls during emergencies
